memory.scope: Chromium JS heap estimate; excludes GPU and server

input_count_scope: Since last reset; frame/latency percentiles describe retained samples only.
notes: Developer-only local trace; no typed dialogue or NPC private state.
Frame callback/render measurements are not physical-device or GPU benchmarks.
Next-changed-actor draw can be continuing prior animation and is not causally attributed to the input.

Committed-actor draw includes only inputs accepted with no active navigation or remaining animation, followed by the matching accepted move and a changed actor draw. Nonidle, cancelled, superseded and unmoved inputs are excluded, not zero latency.
Draw ends at JavaScript Canvas submission, not browser composition or physical display.
Backend samples include local HTTP and serialization; they do not isolate Python CPU.
Pathfinding CPU is measured separately in the Python navigation study.
